en: Added `x-claude-code-request-class`, `x-claude-code-agent-type`, `x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations`, `x-claude-code-compaction` and `x-claude-code-context-compacted` request headers for LLM gateways; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`
zh: 为 LLM 网关新增 `x-claude-code-request-class`、`x-claude-code-agent-type`、`x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations`、`x-claude-code-compaction` 和 `x-claude-code-context-compacted` 请求头；通过 `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1` 启用
